variants.title: Moessbauer spectrum of austenitic stainless steel
variants.note: Austenitic steel is not magnetic at room temperature and its cubic site has no field gradient: a single line, whose shift against alpha-iron is the isomer shift (about -0.09 mm/s, quoted from memory - verify).

variants.title: Moessbauer spectrum of hematite
variants.sample: Alpha-Fe2O3 hematite powder at room temperature (SIMULATED)
variants.unknown: hyperfine field, isomer shift, quadrupole shift
variants.note: Fe3+ in an antiferromagnet: a larger field than iron metal (51.7 T), a positive isomer shift (0.37 mm/s) and a quadrupole shift that moves the outer lines against the inner four (2 eps = -0.2 mm/s). All three quoted from memory - verify.

source.title: Greenwood and Gibb, Moessbauer Spectroscopy (1971): hematite

variants.title: Moessbauer spectrum of sodium nitroprusside
variants.note: Low-spin Fe(II) in a strongly distorted site: no magnetic splitting but a large field gradient, so a doublet 1.712 mm/s apart centred at -0.257 mm/s against alpha-iron; it is a common velocity-calibration standard. Values quoted from memory - verify.

source.title: Greenwood and Gibb, Moessbauer Spectroscopy (1971): sodium nitroprusside
